table.name: Breeds
table.purpose: Lookup table of dog breeds, referenced by the Dogs table. Each row is one breed with a short code and its full name.

breed_code.name: breed_code
breed_code.description: Primary key. Short three-letter code identifying a dog breed (e.g. ESK = Eskimo, HUS = Husky, BUL = Bulldog). Referenced by Dogs.breed_code.

breed_name.name: breed_name
breed_name.description: Full display name of the breed corresponding to the breed code.

table.name: Charges
table.purpose: Lookup/price list of veterinary charges: each row is a billable charge type with its amount (likely in the smallest currency unit, e.g., cents, given BIGINT values like 98–640). Referenced by treatments presumably via charge_id.

charge_amount.name: charge_amount
charge_amount.description: Price of the charge type. Declared BIGINT with values 98–640; likely stored in minor currency units (cents) rather than a currency unit, though with only 3 rows this is tentative.

charge_id.name: charge_id
charge_id.description: Primary key identifying each charge entry.

charge_type.name: charge_type
charge_type.description: Name of the charge category, e.g., 'Daily Accommodation', 'Drugs', 'Health Check'.

table.name: Dogs
table.purpose: Animal-shelter / kennel register: one row per dog, tracking its arrival at the facility, adoption by an owner, and departure, along with breed, size, age and physical attributes. Referenced by Treatments for medical care records.

abandoned_yn.name: abandoned_flag
abandoned_yn.description: Flag indicating whether the dog was abandoned (1 = yes, 0 = no); 3 of 15 dogs were abandoned.

age.name: age_years
age.description: Age of the dog in whole years (values 1-9).

breed_code.name: breed_code
breed_code.description: Foreign key to Breeds.breed_code; three-letter code for the dog's breed (ESK = Eskimo, HUS = Husky, BUL = Bulldog).

date_adopted.name: adoption_date
date_adopted.description: Timestamp when the dog was adopted; all values fall in Feb-Mar 2018, after arrival and around departure.

date_arrived.name: arrival_date
date_arrived.description: Timestamp when the dog arrived at the shelter/kennel (Apr 2017 - Jan 2018).

date_departed.name: departure_date
date_departed.description: Timestamp when the dog left the facility; all values cluster on 2018-03-24/25, consistent with a batch departure/adoption event.

date_of_birth.name: date_of_birth
date_of_birth.description: The dog's date of birth (2008-2018). Note: in some rows it is inconsistent with the age column (e.g. dog 7 born 2017-09-19 but age 2), so age and birth date do not always agree.

dog_id.name: dog_id
dog_id.description: Primary key; unique identifier of the dog. Referenced by Treatments.dog_id for its treatment records.

gender.name: gender
gender.description: Binary gender flag (0/1). Which value maps to male vs female is not determinable from the data; the joins provide no additional evidence.

name.name: name
name.description: The dog's given name (all unique in this sample).

owner_id.name: owner_id
owner_id.description: Foreign key to Owners.owner_id; the owner who adopted the dog. Some owners (e.g. 14) adopted more than one dog.

size_code.name: size_code
size_code.description: Foreign key to Sizes.size_code; the dog's size class (SML = Small, MED = Medium, LGE = Large).

weight.name: weight
weight.description: The dog's weight, numeric (1.39-9.8). The unit is not evident from the data; values are small for dogs of these breeds, so kilograms is plausible but pounds would be unusually low - unit unresolved. The joins provide no additional evidence.

table.name: Owners
table.purpose: Pet owners registered at a veterinary clinic; each row is one dog owner with contact and address details, referenced by the Dogs table.

cell_number.name: cell_number
cell_number.description: Owner's mobile/cell phone number, stored as text in varied formats (with extensions, country codes, punctuation).

home_phone.name: home_phone
home_phone.description: Owner's home/landline phone number, stored as text in varied formats.

owner_id.name: owner_id
owner_id.description: Primary key identifying the owner; referenced by Dogs.owner_id (a dog belongs to one owner).

state.name: state
state.description: Owner's U.S. state of residence (written without spaces, e.g. 'NorthDakota', 'NewYork').

street.name: street
street.description: Owner's street address including house number and unit/suite.

zip_code.name: zip_code
zip_code.description: Owner's U.S. ZIP code (5-digit, stored as text with leading zeros).

table.name: Professionals
table.purpose: Staff members of a veterinary clinic (veterinarians and other employees) who perform treatments on dogs; each row is one staff member with contact and address details. Referenced by Treatments.professional_id, indicating which professional carried out each treatment.

cell_number.name: cell_number
cell_number.description: Mobile phone number of the professional, stored as free-formatted text with varied punctuation and extensions.

home_phone.name: home_phone
home_phone.description: Home/landline phone number of the professional, stored as free-formatted text with varied formats and extensions.

professional_id.name: professional_id
professional_id.description: Primary key identifying the professional; referenced by Treatments.professional_id to record who performed each treatment.

role_code.name: role_code
role_code.description: Job role of the staff member: 'Veterenarian' (sic, misspelled Veterinarian) or 'Employee' (non-veterinarian staff).

state.name: state
state.description: U.S. state of the professional's address (full state names, sometimes without spaces, e.g. 'NorthCarolina').

street.name: street
street.description: Street portion of the professional's mailing address; values are multi-line and also embed city, state and ZIP, so the separate city/state/zip_code columns appear inconsistent with the embedded address text.

zip_code.name: zip_code
zip_code.description: U.S. ZIP code of the professional's address (5-digit, stored as text with leading zeros).

table.name: Sizes
table.purpose: Lookup table of dog size categories, referenced by Dogs.size_code. Each row is one size category with a code and its full description.

size_code.name: size_code
size_code.description: Primary key. Abbreviated size category code: SML = Small, MED = Medium, LGE = Large. Referenced by Dogs.size_code.

size_description.name: size_description
size_description.description: Full human-readable label of the size category (Small, Medium, Large), one-to-one with size_code.

table.name: Treatment_Types
table.purpose: Lookup table of treatment/service types offered for dogs (e.g., exams, vaccinations, walks), referenced by the Treatments table in a veterinary/dog-care database.

treatment_type_code.name: treatment_type_code
treatment_type_code.description: Short code identifying the treatment type (EXAM, VAC, WALK); primary key, referenced by Treatments.treatment_type_code.

treatment_type_description.name: treatment_type_description
treatment_type_description.description: Human-readable description of the treatment type (e.g., 'Physical examination', 'Vaccination', 'Take for a Walk').

table.name: Treatments
table.purpose: Records individual treatment/procedure events performed on dogs by professionals, with date, type, and cost. Each row is one treatment given to one dog by one professional (a veterinary/clinic context).

cost_of_treatment.name: cost_of_treatment
cost_of_treatment.description: Cost charged for the treatment, in whole currency units (e.g. dollars/cents as integer). Ranges 139–945, all distinct, no nulls.

date_of_treatment.name: date_of_treatment
date_of_treatment.description: Timestamp (date and time) when the treatment was performed. Stored as VARCHAR but values are valid timestamps; range Feb 26 – Mar 24, 2018.

dog_id.name: dog_id
dog_id.description: Foreign key to Dogs.dog_id — the dog that received the treatment (many treatments per dog).

professional_id.name: professional_id
professional_id.description: Foreign key to Professionals.professional_id — the staff member who performed/administered the treatment.

treatment_id.name: treatment_id
treatment_id.description: Primary key of the Treatments table; unique identifier for each treatment event.

treatment_type_code.name: treatment_type_code
treatment_type_code.description: Foreign key to Treatment_Types.treatment_type_code — code for the kind of treatment: EXAM (Physical examination), VAC (Vaccination), WALK (Take for a Walk).
